policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 26 May close (1x4 3.89, 3x6 4.00, 6x9 4.29, 9x12 4.52 vs WIBOR 3M 3.86) price roughly 65bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 6 May (core probably rose in April; wait-and-see); Glapiński (7 May): the probability of a hike has risen and a cut is very unlikely - a CPI breach of 3.5% with persistent forecasts would trigger action. The April voting record (22 May) shows Tyrowicz's 100bp hike motion rejected with all others against; Glapiński (18 May): no commitments. April CPI 3.2% (final, 15 May; flash 30 Apr, 3.0% expected); core 3.0% (18 May). May flash CPI is due 29 May (Erste ~3.7%). The fuel VAT and excise cuts were extended to 31 May (13 May).
policy.risk_text: Deal hopes pulled Brent below $100 and trimmed hike pricing; the risks are a collapse of the US-Iran memorandum (US strikes on 26 May) and May CPI (29 May, ~3.7% expected) above 3.5%; long end: June supply and the deficit.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026; IMF (14 Apr): 2026 CPI 3.3%; EC (21 May): GDP 3.5% in 2026. The July projection is the next marker.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.3% of GDP (GUS EDP, 22 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; budget deficit after April PLN 89.3bn (30.1% of the limit); the fiscal notification and the government's assumptions put the 2026 deficit at ~6.8% of GDP; EC (21 May): 6.5%, debt 64.5%; the SAFE loan was signed on 8 May; windfall-tax bill due in Q2 (75% of margins above the 2025 level +20%); fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise, price caps) extended to 31 May (13 May).
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~54% (MoF, 25 May) financed; budget accounts ~PLN 184bn at end-April (MoF estimate); 8 May T-bill PLN 3.66bn at 4.151%; CHF 885m priced on 21 May (first CHF deal since 2015). S&P affirmed A-/stable (8 May) and its analyst calls the missing medium-term consolidation the key rating risk (26 May); Scope A negative (15 May); Fitch and Moody's negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May; April CPI 3.2% y/y; Q1 GDP 3.4% y/y (flash). Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable (affirmed 8 May). 26 May: unemployment 6.0%; S&P's Vartapetov: the fiscal position, with no medium-term consolidation, is the key rating risk; Motyka: the CPN package runs to at least mid-June; BNP: CPI ~4% at end-2026; BGK set a 28 May FPC tender; after overnight US strikes on Iran IRS fell 8-9bp and FRAs 5-9bp (Erste) while bonds were flat (DS0436 5.76%); DB: core supports an H2 hike. Abroad: US 'self-defence' strikes in southern Iran dented deal hopes but Rubio still sees a deal within days; Brent ~$100; Bund 2.98%, UST 10Y 4.50%; the MNB held at 6.25% and sees room to ease; Schnabel wants a June ECB hike even with a peace deal.

calendar.plan_text: MoF May plan (30 Apr): sale auctions on 13 May (PLN 6-12bn), 21 May (7-13bn) and 27 May (6-12bn) in OK0129 (new 2Y, replaces OK0128), NZ0331, PS0731, DS0436 and NZ0936; a 46-week T-bill on 8 May (3-6bn); no switch. ~49% of 2026 needs financed after the April sales. 8 May T-bill: PLN 3.66bn at 4.151% plus 0.55bn. 13 May sale: PLN 11.01bn vs 13.73bn demand (cover 1.25) plus 0.85bn; OK0129 4.868%, PS0731 5.360%, DS0436 5.854%, PS0130 5.018%. 21 May sale: PLN 10.00bn vs 13.28bn demand (cover 1.33) plus 0.04bn; OK0129 4.887%, PS0731 5.433%, DS0436 5.883%, DS1034 5.718%. CHF 885m priced (3Y/7Y/10Y green). 27 May offer (25 May): PLN 7-11bn (DS1033 added). BGK FPC (14 May): PLN 0.84bn on 1.10bn demand plus 0.15bn.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it and April's auction days cheapened on average. Remaining May sales: 27 May. Next MPC 1-2 Jun: a hold is expected; the July projection is the next marker. Covers: 1.25 (13 May), 1.33 (21 May) vs 1.13-1.25 in April.

core_text: Regime: a 60-day US-Iran memorandum within reach - Brent below $100, Bund back under 3%; the NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May while FRAs price roughly 65bp of NBP hikes; the ECB is priced for a June hike, the BoE for hikes, the Fed has turned to hike risk under Warsh, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 53bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 280bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 26 May close). US strikes in Iran; Brent $100; MNB holds (26 May).
